name: Naturalisation by Registration (residence)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 7 years' ordinary residence in Dominica (Constitution, Section 100), for applicants who are citizens of a Commonwealth country.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 7 years' ordinary residence in Dominica.

sources.title: UN Women Constitutions Database -- Constitution of the Commonwealth of Dominica, Section 100 (registration/naturalisation)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Dominica's initial build. STATUS SET TO DRAFT, deliberately: the substance (7-year ordinary residence for Commonwealth-citizen applicants, per Section 100 of the Constitution) is a genuine constitutional provision, but the only source found reproducing it in this pass is a UN Women legal database (an intergovernmental host, tier 2 by this dataset's convention), not a Dominica government domain. The Citizenship Act PDF hosted at cbiu.gov.dm (the natural tier-1 source) returned no machine-readable text when fetched; a Dominica-government-hosted copy of the Constitution or Act was not located either. This route should be revisited and upgraded to 'published' if a dominica.gov.dm-hosted or Official Gazette copy of the Constitution/Citizenship Act can be fetched to confirm the same figure at tier-1. Non-Commonwealth-citizen naturalisation grounds (if they differ) are not covered here -- only the Commonwealth-citizen ground stated in Section 100 was found. prerequisites is null: the Constitution does not explicitly require formal PR status before this ground, so no sequencing requirement is asserted; dm_permanent_residence's own switchable_to lists this route as a plausible (not confirmed-required) next step instead.
